bible.title: Medieval Castle
bible.intent: A fortress holding a mountain pass, in its B6 rebuild. Start at the waymark on the approach, cross the bridge over the gorge, pass the gatehouse between the round gate towers and look up to the curtain, terraces and keep. This revision is a partial assembly for a work-in-progress showing, not final art.
bible.rules: Placements labelled DRAFT are unsaved builds and placements labelled STAND-IN are grey collider-box stand-ins; neither is accepted content, so replace them with saved modules rather than polishing them. Keep a clear walking route from the approach across the bridge and through the gate. Ground walls, towers and footings on the heightmap terrain, and check real terrain and collider support after edits; visual terrain alone does not establish walkability.
